title: お届け、ホットステージ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA is currently hosting a fan meet. Smart Falcon makes an appearance at a trivia game, along with a few others.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yippee! ♪ Falco gets it right once again! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon is bringing her A game and breezing through the questions. On the other hand…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon has yet to make a move for the buzzer, and Agnes Tachyon is completely disinterested. The crowd doesn't look enthused…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Okay.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm just too smart for my own good, hehe. ♪ But, having no competition is a bit boring.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I know! How about we have the audience decide the questions instead?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And, if you don't get first place… You've gotta do a dare as punishment! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes into a frenzy—her idea receives a hearty applause!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon asks for the audience's participation, doing her best to liven things up.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As for the punishment, let's see… How about this? The two losers have to down one of Tachyon's special drinks!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Have you taken an interest in my prototype concoctions? What a fabulous opportunity for some experimentation, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'd be happy to oblige! You will certainly have a taste, don't worry about that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, looks like Tachyon is getting serious! Bourbon, you need to be on your A game! That is, unless you're ready to have that drink!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is a possibility that the buzzer will break if I touch it. Would you like to proceed knowing the risks?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What?! So that's why you haven't been answering? All right, just raise your hand from now on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right again. You two might want to prepare yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Detecting an increase in Tachyon's probability of winning. Now removing limiters. Boosting arms for maximum hand-raising speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her new set of rules, Smart Falcon has pressured the others into upping their own game. The crowd is completely tuned in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Those two are super strong when they get serious!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want to win this thing, with all of you! So… give me a good question, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Falco Fans
text_block_list.text: Falcoooo! We've got you, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon has the brains, Mihono Bourbon can raise her hand in just 0.1 seconds, and Smart Falcon has the support of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The quiz turns into a tug-of-war, with each competitor leveraging their distinct strengths. The fans go wild! But eventually…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay, I'm the winner! ♪ All right, you two. Down the hatch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I've undergone countless experiments. You won't find much entertainment in seeing someone like me consume this. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Warning! Warning! Major system error detected!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Halting auxiliary functions. Shutting down main systems. Projected time until taste buds regain function: long.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yikes, that looks pretty horrible! Well done to you, Bourbon. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, next up is Tachyon. ♪ Make sure you finish every last drop! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Woooo! It's not every day you see Tachyon and Bourbon react like that! Things like this make life worth living!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haha! ☆ What a great reaction from the both of you. ♪ I declare this event a huuuge success! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The trivia game ends as a great success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that went well. ♪ The event turned out to be a lotta fun.
choice_data_list: I wasn't sure if things were going to pan out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haha! ♪ I'm sure those two were a little confused on what to do, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But I knew they could shine on stage, and so did the fans. ♪ I just created an opportunity for them!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The event turned out well because everyone put in the effort. And that's the most enjoyable part about being on stage! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The event turned out well because everyone put in the effort. And that's the most enjoyable part about being on stage! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If there's a stage involved, you know who to call! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But… I probably could've gotten things going faster. Yep, I still have much to learn!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When her fans are involved, you can always count on Smart Falcon to get out of a pinch!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ♪ But, we're not done just yet. I need to give my fans a little more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna snap some photos for Umasta. ♪ Now where did Bourbon and Tachyon get off to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When it comes to entertaining her fans, she goes above and beyond. I can really feel how much pride she has in being an Umadol!
